validator_telemetry_redirected.canonical: However, the about 9 months figure is an estimate based on interviews. It is not a rule that applies to every company, and it is not a promise that prices will fall in 9 months. It is too soon to mark the date on your calendar. And a cup at a cafe comes with costs besides the beans. One cafe operator in Chicago said that the cost of cups and labor, as well as the cost of buying beans, had been behind price increases. Even if bean prices fall, other costs do not always fall along with them. If you are waiting for the price of your usual cup to come down, think not only, How much do beans cost now? but also, When does the price of the beans reach here? A coffee price tag may have an unseen clock of its own, separate from the latest news about the market.
